additional_concerns: The scope condition nav > 0 is an additional restriction not stated in the circular. It returns OUT_OF_SCOPE for zero or negative NAV, even when an applicable SFC designation exists. Clarify whether such NAV values should instead trigger unresolved measurement or validity handling.
The doubled exposure sum correctly expresses the inclusive 50% threshold: 2 × (direct_exposure + indirect_exposure) >= nav. It does not impose a 100% threshold.

The representation refers to a supplied exposure methodology, but none is supplied in this packet. Valuation, look-through, aggregation and avoidance of double counting remain unresolved; identify the governing methodology before applying the formula to holdings.
The assessment-time convention is an implementation assumption. The packet does not establish measurement dates, reassessment frequency or when a designation ceases to apply.

The global conflict-blocking rule can prevent a result even when the threshold or an applicable designation independently establishes classification. This is a declared evidence-handling convention, not a requirement established by the circular.
The three missing dependency IDs have no supplied mapping to named authorities. None can safely be assigned to a particular external authority.
Footnote 1 separately identifies the UT Code 7.3 direct-investment limit. The classification formula does not assess that limit; a classification result cannot establish investment-limit compliance.
